name: Valency
description: Valency Bond — Ground any AI assistant in the live scientific literature. Bond connects Claude to a continuously updated corpus of papers and preprints from trusted sources including arXiv, bioRxiv, medRxiv, and PubMed, refreshed every few hours so new work is reachable within hours of publication. With 38+ tools spanning semantic and metadata search, researcher profiles, co-author mapping, forward and backward citation graphs, publication and keyword trend analysis, and clean JSON or CSV export, Bond powers a full research workflow from first search to final citation. Responses are token-efficient and structured, so grounding your model adds real, current sources without flooding its context window. Ask questions the way you always have, and get back grounded answers with verifiable citations attached. Free for researchers, academics, and non-profits.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Valency to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Valency to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.valency.io/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Valency MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Valency lists 38 MCP tools, including analyze_corpus_metrics, batch_author_categories, compare_authors, count_papers, export_from_filter, export_papers_bibtex, export_papers_csv, export_papers_json, filter_by_categories, filter_by_date_range, filter_by_license, and filter_papers_with_doi.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Valency?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Valency in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
Valency requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Valency is developed by Valency Systems Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
